verdict.rationale: Docs confirm agents can programmatically create tens/hundreds/thousands of inboxes on demand and manage many pods/inboxes via scoped API keys, which supports bulk-scale automation. However, there's no documented batch/bulk endpoint for operations like mass message sending, bulk thread updates, or batch deletes—only single-item message/thread APIs are described. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API operations for messages or threads, evidence of rate-limit-aware bulk processing, independent confirmation of bulk usage at scale.
